rules.B1: per component, min usd_per_hour/vcpu of its fixed shape; ties -> lower compute+storage monthly bill -> smallest location id (D-039). Egress ignored when choosing, charged when scored.
rules.B2: per provider, the single region minimising total compute+storage; ties -> smallest location id.
rules.B2-best: B2 provider with the lowest evaluated total; ties -> aws, azure, gcp order.
rules.egress_share: inter-component egress_usd / total_usd; internet egress reported separately (D-040).
rules.seed: empty: all M08 methods are deterministic.
